knowledge:
- key_parameters: type=Specifies the type of peak calling, either 'consensus' (for single-condition replicate analysis) or 'differential' (for multi-condition analysis) ;; dist=Specifies the count distribution, either 'zinb' (zero-inflated negative binomial, recommended for consensus peak calling) or 'nb' (negative binomial) ;; span=Parameter for loessFit in normalizeCounts, defaults to 1 which is recommended for both broad and short marks ;; pruningThreshold=Threshold in controlEM (e.g., 0.05) to sequentially prune rare differential combinatorial patterns of enrichment with small mixture posterior proportions ;; method=FDR control thresholding level in callPeaks (e.g., 0.05) to define peak regions at the window level; if omitted, Viterbi algorithm is used by default ;; gapTrack=Logical or GRanges object in epigraHMMDataSetFromBam to exclude genomic coordinates overlapping gap regions ;; blackList=Logical or GRanges object in epigraHMMDataSetFromBam to exclude ENCODE blacklisted regions
- alternatives: csaw::normOffsets=The non-linear normalization in normalizeCounts is based on a loess smoothing fit similar to csaw::normOffsets ;; gcapc=Can be used for GC-content normalization, with offsets added to epigraHMM via addOffsets
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing high-throughput epigenomic assays (ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq, DNase-seq, etc.) to detect consensus peaks across replicates or differential peaks across multiple conditions, particularly for marks exhibiting short and broad peaks.
- pitfalls: Failing to use normalizeCounts can leave non-linear biases uncorrected. If using custom offsets (like GC-content via addOffsets), normalizeCounts must be run last because it considers existing offsets. BAM index files (.bai) must be in the same directory as BAM files and named with the .bai suffix. Input colData must contain exactly named columns 'condition' and 'replicate'. If using countData as a list of matrices, it must contain a named matrix 'counts' (and optionally 'controls').

workflows.name: consensus_peak_calling
workflows.intent: Detect consensus enrichment regions (peaks) across technical or biological replicates of a single experimental condition.
input: bamFiles (character vector of paths to BAM files and their corresponding .bai index files)
colData (data.frame containing sample metadata with 'condition' and 'replicate' columns)
workflows.stages: 1. Load BAM files and create an epigraHMMDataSet using epigraHMMDataSetFromBam ;; 2. Create an EM control object using controlEM ;; 3. Normalize counts using normalizeCounts ;; 4. Initialize the model parameters using initializer ;; 5. Run the HMM model for consensus peak detection using epigraHMM with type = 'consensus' ;; 6. Call peaks using callPeaks ;; 7. Visualize peaks and normalized counts using plotCounts
workflows.code:
bamFiles <- system.file(package="genomationData","extdata",
                        "wgEncodeBroadHistoneH1hescCtcfStdAlnRep1.chr21.bam")

colData <- data.frame(condition = "CTCF",
                      replicate = 1)

object_consensus <- epigraHMMDataSetFromBam(bamFiles = bamFiles,
                                            colData = colData,
                                            genome = 'hg19',
                                            windowSize = 500,
                                            gapTrack = TRUE,
                                            blackList = TRUE)

control <- controlEM(fileName = 'control-consensus')

object_consensus <- normalizeCounts(object_consensus,
                                    control = control)

object_consensus <- initializer(object_consensus,control)

object_consensus <- epigraHMM(object = object_consensus,
                              control = control,
                              type = 'consensus')

peaks_consensus <- callPeaks(object = object_consensus)

library(rtracklayer)
library(Seqinfo)

session <- browserSession()
genome(session) <- 'hg19'
refSeq <- getTable(ucscTableQuery(session, table = "refGene"))

annotation <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(refSeq,
                                       starts.in.df.are.0based = TRUE,
                                       seqnames.field = 'chrom',
                                       start.field = 'txStart',
                                       end.field = 'txEnd',
                                       strand.field = 'strand',
                                       keep.extra.columns = TRUE)

gr_consensus <- GRanges('chr21',IRanges(41108537,41185351))

plotCounts(object = object_consensus,
           ranges = gr_consensus,
           peaks = peaks_consensus,
           annotation = annotation)

workflows.name: differential_peak_calling
workflows.intent: Detect differential enrichment regions (peaks) across multiple experimental conditions and classify peaks into combinatorial patterns of enrichment.
input: bamFiles (list or vector of paths to BAM files for multiple conditions)
colData (data.frame containing sample metadata with 'condition' and 'replicate' columns)
workflows.stages: 1. Load BAM files for multiple conditions and create an epigraHMMDataSet using epigraHMMDataSetFromBam ;; 2. Create an EM control object using controlEM ;; 3. Normalize counts using normalizeCounts ;; 4. Initialize the model parameters using initializer ;; 5. Run the HMM model for differential peak detection using epigraHMM with type = 'differential' ;; 6. Call peaks using callPeaks ;; 7. Extract and classify differential combinatorial patterns using callPatterns and info ;; 8. Visualize differential peaks and patterns using plotCounts and plotPatterns
workflows.code:
bamFiles <- system.file(package="genomationData","extdata",
                        c("wgEncodeBroadHistoneH1hescCtcfStdAlnRep1.chr21.bam",
                          "wgEncodeBroadHistoneH1hescSuz12051317AlnRep1.chr21.bam"))

colData <- data.frame(condition = c("CTCF","SUZ12"),
                      replicate = c(1,1))

object_differential <- epigraHMMDataSetFromBam(bamFiles = bamFiles,
                                               colData = colData,
                                               genome = 'hg19',
                                               windowSize = 500,
                                               gapTrack = TRUE,
                                               blackList = TRUE)

control <- controlEM(fileName = 'control-differential',criterion = 'MACPE')

object_differential <- normalizeCounts(object_differential,control)

object_differential <- initializer(object_differential,control)

object_differential <- epigraHMM(object = object_differential,
                                 control = control,
                                 type = 'differential')

peaks_differential <- callPeaks(object = object_differential)

library(rtracklayer)
library(Seqinfo)

session <- browserSession()
genome(session) <- 'hg19'
refSeq <- getTable(ucscTableQuery(session, table = "refGene"))

annotation <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(refSeq,
                                       starts.in.df.are.0based = TRUE,
                                       seqnames.field = 'chrom',
                                       start.field = 'txStart',
                                       end.field = 'txEnd',
                                       strand.field = 'strand',
                                       keep.extra.columns = TRUE)

gr_differential <- GRanges('chr21',IRanges(41198328,41352762))

plotCounts(object = object_differential,
           ranges = gr_differential,
           peaks = peaks_differential,
           annotation = annotation)

pattern_peak <- peaks_differential[overlapsAny(peaks_differential,gr_differential)]

plotPatterns(object = object_differential,
             ranges = pattern_peak[4],
             peaks = peaks_differential)

info(object_differential)

callPatterns(object = object_differential,peaks = peaks_differential,type = 'all')

callPatterns(object = object_differential,peaks = peaks_differential,type = 'max')
